svg.text: Which Bank Does Each Lane Hit?
32 lanes of one warp, 32 shared-memory banks, one wire per lane · watch the wires converge · loops continuously
Every extra wire arriving at the same bank is one more serialized transaction — the bank serves them one at a time.
For a constant stride, lane t lands on bank (t × stride) mod 32, so the conflict degree is exactly gcd(stride, 32).
That is always a power of two — and it means every odd stride (3, 7, 17, 31) fans out perfectly, costing one transaction just like stride 1.
So a 3-way conflict cannot come from a stride at all. Odd degrees need an irregular pattern: a gather s[idx[t]], or any hand-built index (last phase).
Special case: if lanes read the same address (not merely the same bank), the bank broadcasts — 1 transaction, no conflict.
